reason: I buy lighting from Wayfair, Lumens or West Elm because I know how delivery and returns work there, and I have never heard of this store. The free returns and UL listing are good, but $360 to a brand with almost no reviews is still a gamble for me.
objection: Nobody has heard of them and there are barely any reviews, so I have no proof the paper pendant looks as good in person as in the photos. I would be the guinea pig, and 2 to 3 weeks of waiting is a long time to find that out.
would_change_my_mind: A decent number of verified reviews with real customer photos, or the same pendant at a retailer I already trust.
